The last interview we had a month ago, you were telling about the trombone players like Eddie Benson over in Algiers. Could you tell us some more about him when you first met him?

items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1959-12-09
items.q: And Eddie Benson. We used to practice right over the way from the gate.

ctx.x: And Eddie Benson. We used to practice right over the way from the gate.

Well, I think we only have a couple minutes left. Can you tell us anything about Eddie Vinson? Because naturally he's dead and we'll never learn much about him, but people like you could tell us a little about him.
